audit.trigger: Selecting successive photos in a persistent native runtime
audit.disposition: Large bounded working set, not observed history growth. Cache retains one feature set; per-request buffers become unreachable; Node and native allocator ownership supply reclamation. No production forced-GC or second worker is introduced.
audit.acceptance_seam: probe:segment reports peak RSS and fails above its explicit canary; repeated masks and encode timing remain separately checked.
audit.rationale: The cold-only 8 GB estimate excludes the measured warm transient peak. 10 GB covers the complete observed workload on the 48 GiB acceptance machine; it is not a visual-quality threshold.
